title: Which cooking oil is the best?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What do you normally consider when choosing a cooking oil: taste, price, health, or cooking temperature?
Why might one oil be good for salad but less suitable for high-heat cooking?
Do labels such as 'natural' or 'heart healthy' strongly influence your choice?
Should households use several different oils for different purposes?
What would make you change the cooking oil you currently use most often?
